tdd_result.description: Integrate connect-bot with shared bindings, preserve HTTP protocol
tdd_result.lastIntent: Notifying peer 21 about the widget wiring fix

behavior_delivered.http_wiring: connect-bot's outbound is now the framework's public HTTP call (`request` from framework/public.ts) instead of an extension-owned transport: each request declares a fixed direct connection (`proxy: false`) and the extension's own configured `timeoutMs` (extensions/connect-bot/shared-logic/panel/client.ts). `PushTransport`, `PushFetchInit`, `PushHttpResponse`, `installPushTransport`, `setPushTransportForTest` and the assembly's `platformTransport` (globalThis.fetch) are deleted with no compat copy; the one seam left is the same-interface `PanelRequest` + `setPanelRequestForTest`. Wire protocol untouched: route /api/sessions/events, {sessionId,kind,data?} envelope, JSON, 4 kinds, register receipt shape, 10s heartbeat, 3-failure budget, working/idle/awaiting-input semantics.
behavior_delivered.model_cost_dispose_wiring: extensions/model-cost/harnesses/omp/widget.ts no longer subscribes `pi.on("session_shutdown", …)`; `harnesses/omp.ts` composes the frontend release into the binding's single framework `cleanup` via `releasingFrontendOnCleanup`, and attaches the frontend only when `bound.bound`, so a refused binding leaves nothing unreleased.
behavior_delivered.docs: extensions/connect-bot/README.md (outbound call section; panel windows corrected to the panel's delivered defaults 10s/30s + fixed 5s scan) and .scratch/model-cost-migration/assets/22-connect-bot-consumer-evidence-2026-10-13.md (per-criterion evidence, commands, failures, limits).
